english.title: Transfer biological agent or toxin to another person or agree to do so
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[transferred]_
(B)_[entered into an agreement to transfer]_

a biological agent or toxin, namely **(..SPECIFY BIOLOGICAL AGENT OR TOXIN..), to another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), when the biological agent or toxin was likely to be kept or used otherwise than for prophylactic, protective or other peaceful purposes and you knew or had reason to believe that that was the case
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1A)(a) and (3) of the Biological Weapons Act 1974.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Prosecution of this offence requires the consent of the Attorney General, see section 2 Biological Weapons Act 1974.
(ii) See section 1A for territorial application and section 1B for prosecution procedure.
